how_to_apply: Download the detailed advertisement and application format from https://mohfw.gov.in or https://pmssy.mohfw.gov.in.
Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma with attested copies of all relevant certificates.
Forward the application through proper channel with APARs, Vigilance Clearance, penalty statement and Integrity Certificate.
Send it to Shri Arvind Thakur, Deputy Secretary (PMSSY-IV), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Room No. 409, D-Wing, Nirman Bhawan, New Delhi-110011.
Superscribe the envelope "Application for the post of Deputy Director (Administration) at new AIIMS".
Application must be received by the 45th day from publication of the advertisement in the Employment News.
Make sure it reaches by 20 December 2026.
important_instructions: Crucial date for length of service and upper age limit is the last date for receipt of applications Any amendment will be published only on https://pmssy.mohfw.gov.in Prescribed qualification/eligibility is minimum and does not automatically make a candidate eligible for selection

content_sections.heading: MoHFW Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. Z-28015/45/2025-PMSSY-IV(8323809) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MoHFW notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers under the Central/State/U.T. Government/Universities/Statutory/Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organisation holding analogous posts on regular basis; OR Officers at the level of Deputy Secretary of Central Government or equivalent with 5 years' regular service in the Level-12 of Pay Matrix (Rs. 78800-209200) (as per 7th CPC)/(Grade Pay of Rs. 7600/- pre-revised as per 6th CPC) Experience: 5 years' regular service in Level-12 of Pay Matrix (for Deputy Secretary level officers or equivalent) Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the last date for receipt of applications) Other conditions: Only eligible officers who can be spared in the event of selection may apply Application must be forwarded through proper channel

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for MoHFW Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications received not through proper channel may not be considered for interview

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment on transfer on deputation basis Tenure of deputation initially for three years Deputation including preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years

content_sections.heading: How Will MoHFW Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on bio-data Interview Candidates shortlisted based on bio-data Only shortlisted candidates called for interview Bio-data supported by documents assessed by the Selection Committee Original documents to be produced at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in prescribed proforma with attested copies of all relevant certificates Attested copies of up-to-date APARs for last five (05) years Vigilance Clearance Certificate showing no disciplinary or criminal proceedings pending or contemplated Statement showing minor/major penalties imposed, if any Integrity Certificate Certificate by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority (part of proforma)

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Crucial date for length of service and upper age limit is the last date for receipt of applications Any amendment will be published only on https://pmssy.mohfw.gov.in Prescribed qualification/eligibility is minimum and does not automatically make a candidate eligible for selection

content_sections.heading: MoHFW Deputy Director (Administration) Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MoHFW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MoHFW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Deputy Director (Administration).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MoHFW Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application proforma on pages 3 to 5 of this PDF; also on https://mohfw.gov.in and https://pmssy.mohfw.gov.in) and send it to Shri Arvind Thakur, Deputy Secretary (PMSSY-IV), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Room No. 409, D-Wing, Nirman Bhawan, New Delhi-110011, by through proper channel by post to the address given, to reach by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the last date for receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-13 (Rs. 123100-215900) as per 7th CPC plus usual allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers under Central/State/U.T. Government/Universities/Statutory/Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organisation holding analogous posts on regular basis, OR officers at the level of Deputy Secretary of Central Government or equivalent with 5 years' regular service in Level-12 of Pay Matrix (Rs. 78800-209200) (as per 7th CPC)/(Grade Pay of Rs. 7600/- pre-revised as per 6th CPC).

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only eligible officers who can be spared in the event of selection may apply. Application must be forwarded through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received not through proper channel may not be considered for interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on bio-data. Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on bio-data. Only shortlisted candidates called for interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on transfer on deputation basis. Tenure of deputation initially for three years. Deputation including preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years.
